sentences.text: The instant application under section 438 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 20 of 2023, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) of IPC, Police Station- Naka Hindola, District- Lucknow.

The contention of the learned counsel for the applicants is that the main accused Rahul Singh and other accused person, except apart the present applicant were arrested on spot and later on, only on the basis of confessional statement, the present applicant has also been implicated.
He added that there is no cogent piece of evidence against the applicant so as to connect her in the instant matter and he has also shown the other falsity in the prosecution story.

He submits that the main accused namely,
Rahul Singh has already been enlarged on regular bail in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6557 of 2023 and submits that the applicant has no previous criminal history which has been mentioned in paragraph no. 23 of the bail application and submits that applicant undertakes that she will not misuse the liberty of anticipatory bail and will always cooperate with the trial proceedings.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6557 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
On the other hand, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State has opposed the contentions aforesaid and submits that after thorough investigation it was found that the applicant is involved in committing offence and there are ample evidences against her and as such, she is not for any relief.
Having heard learned counsels for the parties and after perusal of material placed on record, it transpires that the main accused namely, Rahul Singh has already been enlarged on bail in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6557 of 2023 vide order dated 18.5.2023; The applicant has no previous criminal history which has been mentioned in paragraph no. 23 of the bail application and she was arrested only on the confessional statement of the other co-accused persons, who were arrested on spot.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6557 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and after perusal of the record, this Court find it to be a fit case of anticipatory bail.

List/put up this matter on 12.11.2024.
In the meantime, learned counsel for the State shall file counter affidavit."
5.From perusal of the order it transpire that the main role is assigned to one Rahul Singh, who has already been enlarged on regular bail.
The role of the present applicant, prima facie is to help the main accused for comitting offence.
All these facts have been considered while granting the interim anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Further from perusal of the counter affidavit there is nothing adversial to the fact which have been mentioned in the bail application and the applicant has no previous criminal history and the applicant undertakes that he will always remain present before the investigating officer as well as trial proceedings.
6.Having heard learned counsel for the parties it transpires that there is nothing adversial to the fact mentioned in the bail application.
